text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tracen Meet has<n>arrived, and
visitors are pouring in<n>from across campus and
beyond.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for our race! I'vebeen so excited for this! And I'mdefinitely gonna beat you, so get ready. ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'll see about that. Just you<n>wait, I'll catch
you out there.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you have any idea who she is?<n>The one
talking to Falco over there.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No clue, but if the Smart Falcon seesher as a rival? That means she mightbe one to watch out for.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A playful challenge from Smart<n>Falcon, who is
currently unrivaled on<n>dirt, draws attention to the
as-yet-unknown Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully the pressure doesn't get to<n>her. Nerves
can stiffen the body,<n>restricting range of movement
and<n>ultimately affecting running form.
choice_data_list: Want me to check your muscles for tension?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would you mind? That'd be<n>wonderful, thank
you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though she doesn't look particularly<n>nervous, her
shoulders definitely feel<n>stiff. I begin to gently tap
on them with<n>my fists, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What's this, a shoulder massage?<n>Why, thank you.
Don't go easy on<n>my account, though. It'd perk me
right<n>up if you put a little oomph into it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I guess a weak massage isn't going<n>to relieve any
tension in the body or<n>mind. I put some more
strength—and<n>heart—into each hit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Yes, that's more like it! Now I'm<n>all fired up
and ready to get that win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're blessed with clear skies for<n>our tenth race, a
2,000-meter on dirt.<n>They're all lined up in the gate...
and<n>here's the start!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Off to an excellent start as always is<n>Smart Falcon.
She shoots to the front<n>like an arrow!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
This is a runner who can fly away<n>with a lead. Let
the gap grow too big,<n>and it'll be impossible to
close it later<n>on.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hrryahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Holy smokes! The dirt really is<n>Falco's domain! No
way anyone's<n>catching up to her!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But look... see that one runner still<n>hanging on?
Wait, we saw her earlier,<n>the one who looked like
she had her<n>head in the clouds!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I won't lose... I won't be knocked<n>down... I'll
show that here!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up, is she nuts?! A<n>pre-debut runner
trying to keep pace<n>with Falco is bound to end in
disaster.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but she is locked in... I mean,it's crazy she can even match thatspeed in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I can do this... Trainer taught me all I<n>need to know,
with patience and<n>sincerity... And it all pays
off—now!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You should stretch your right leg a bit<n>more.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (You would never see all of usrunners as one and the same. Yousaw me for me, looked me straight in the eye...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thank your own tenacity—it's your<n>secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thank your own tenacity—it's your<n>secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(You saw things I never noticed,<n>showed me a
strength I never knew I<n>had. You honed it with me,
so it would<n>be my secret weapon.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(You are... the most incredible<n>person... and if you
can't see that,<n>then I'll show you.)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...You're still keeping up. You really<n>trained hard for
this, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But sorry, 'cause Falco here... is just<n>getting
started!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're past the final corner and<n>into the stretch.
Smart Falcon's lead<n>only grows and grows—she's
flying<n>home!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute might be done! Little by<n>little, the gap
is widening!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Nooo, it's over. But she held on for so<n>long!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Why are you surprised? It's Falco<n>she's up
against! If anything, it's<n>wild that a pre-debut
runner was able<n>to keep up as long as she did.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The race is already over in the eyes<n>of the crowd
around me. I don't<n>blame them. Wonder Acute is a
no-name student who hasn't even<n>debuted.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I alone know her tenacity, her<n>strength that enables
her to go to<n>endless lengths for the sake of<n>others...
her passion.
choice_data_list: You can do it! Trust in all your hard work!
You can do it! Trust in all your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You betcha!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up! I won't be knocked<n>down! I'll run...
till the very end!<n>Hahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes! Wonder Acute finds<n>a new gear!
With the last of her<n>strength, she bears down on
Smart<n>Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't believe my eyes. Are we<n>really seeing
this caliber of<n>performance from a pre-debut<n>runner?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a miracle spurt is Wonder<n>Acute! Can
she do it? Who'll it be?!<n>It's Falcon! It's Acute! It's
gonna<n>be...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: (The crowd goes wild!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's run in the Tracen<n>Meet ends in
narrow defeat.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry about today. I just<n>couldn't pull
through in the end.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought I could beat Falco<n>and give you
a nice little boost in<n>confidence, but...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The dogged fight she gave down the<n>stretch was
something we fostered<n>together. After seeing that, I
can't call<n>myself unfit to be a trainer anymore.
choice_data_list: Plus, you've given me a new goal.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When the two of them crossed the<n>finish line nearly
neck and neck,<n>amidst the roar of the crowd I heard
someone say...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: She lost... but, wow. I think she<n>inspired me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her unfaltering pursuit warmed<n>people's hearts. If
she knew that,<n>I'm sure it'd give her the courage
to<n>do it time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But I've seen how far she can push<n>herself for
others' sakes.<n>Overexertion could knock her to the
ground one day—unless she has<n>someone to lean
on.
choice_data_list: This time, will you let me be your support?
This time, will you let me be your support?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You mean to say... you'd be<n>willing to stay on
as my trainer, is that<n>it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, I'd just as soon be the one<n>asking you. You
really do like<n>underselling yourself, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I hope to see you at<n>training tomorrow.
And don't you<n>worry, I won't bend or break so
easily, so be as tough as you like,<n>you hear?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She chuckles as if she's just joking<n>around, but I
know her well enough<n>by now to see the fighting
spirit<n>smoldering in those gentle eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Some things can only be found at the<n>end of a long
and arduous road. With<n>Wonder Acute by my side, I
know<n>we'll get there in due time.
